content:
Marco Rossi: Aurelia Labs (acct: AURE-009) reported recurring card declines on invoice INV-4699. Their portal shows 'card_declined_insufficient_funds' but customer insists card is fine. They need the service restored today. Any quick checks?
Priya Desai: Did we get a decline code from Stripe? Sometimes it's soft decline and retry works. Also check if card is expired or flagged for 3DS.
PaymentsBot: ALERT: Payment attempt failed for INV-4699. Error: card_declined (code: 402-INSF). Retry attempts: 0. Suggested action: retry scheduled per dunning config or ask for new payment method.
Marco Rossi: Stripe event: ```
{
  "id": "evt_1JY0Zg2eZvKYlo2C",
  "type": "charge.failed",
  "failure_message": "Your card has insufficient funds.",
  "metadata": {"account":"AURE-009","invoice":"INV-4699"}
}
```
Liam O'Connor: If it's insufficient funds, retry in 24 hours is standard. But customer says it's urgent. We can offer an alternate path: temporary 'emergency credit' hold for up to 3 days (requires finance approval) or take a manual ACH/wire.
Priya Desai: Emergency credit needs approval from VP finance — @Nora Li — and a signed promissory email. For manual payment we need customer's authorization to accept a one-time card manually or provide bank details for wire.
Marco Rossi: Customer sent a screenshot saying their bank blocked the charge due to 'merchant flagged'. They can try a different card now. Do we want to accept a manual card entry over PCI link?
PaymentsBot: NOTE: Manual card entry link generated: https://billing.redwood.ai/one-time-pay?inv=INV-4699 (expires in 1 hour). Audit tag: PAY-MANUAL-4699.
Liam O'Connor: Ok. Marco, send the link and ask for a new card. If they can't, offer same-day wire: payload below — but wire needs approval for amounts >$5k. INV is $7,900.
Marco Rossi: Draft wire payload: ```
Wire USD 7,900.00
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Account: 987654321
Routing: 111000025
Bank: FirstFederal Bank
Ref: INV-4699 / AURE-009
```
Priya Desai: I'll ping Nora for approval — tagging finance slack channel and Nora. @Nora Li can you approve same-day wire for $7,900 plus confirm if wire fees pass to customer?
Liam O'Connor: Also log this under dispute-risk if we accept manual card or wire without signed commitment. We should attach the customer's confirmation in the billing ticket PAY-7548.
Nora Li: Quick ack. I approve a one-off wire for $7,900 if customer signs the payment agreement (one-line email is ok) and accepts $25 wire processing fee. Finance will clear after funds settled and proof attached.
Marco Rossi: Sent manual pay link to customer and offered wire option. Customer replied: "We can wire now, please send instructions." Sending wire payload and waiver now.
PaymentsBot: ACTION: Created ticket PAY-7548-WIRE. Please upload proof of funds to the ticket when received.
Priya Desai: Thanks — will update invoice once payment received. Marco, mark thread resolved after confirmation. :white_check_mark:
